description:
[Non-invasive bounded TCP probe with SSRF protection. Read-only, side-effect free]. Probes target host for exposed critical infrastructure ports (MySQL 3306, Postgres 5432, Redis 6379, MongoDB 27017, Elasticsearch 9200, unauthenticated Docker 2375). Strictly non-destructive, with private IP / localhost SSRF protection.
Usage: Use this tool to audit perimeter firewall configuration and identify exposed database ports. Does NOT exploit vulnerabilities or alter server configuration.
Returns: JSON object with { target: string, scannedPortsCount: number, exposedPorts: Array<{ port: number, service: string, riskLevel: 'HIGH' | 'CRITICAL' }>, perimeterSecurityStatus: 'SECURE' | 'EXPOSED', recommendations: string[] }.

customPorts.description: Optional list of specific custom ports to probe (max 10)

hostname.description: Target domain or public IP address to inspect

timeoutMs.description: Per-port socket connect timeout in milliseconds (500-3000ms)

name: port_leak_detector
